objective: Evaluate whether query-oblivious market making remains usable across market thickness and order size, and whether behavioral evidence can safely prioritize suspected multi-credential probing for human review.

immutable_scope.identity_role: behavioral evidence may prioritize review but may never replace KYC or automatically merge legal entities

truth_providers.smoke: seeded synthetic market and labeled synthetic credential pairs
truth_providers.confirmation: held-out seeded simulation with paired seeds and predeclared statistical gates
truth_providers.external_validation: venue-approved historical RF data and independently labeled KYC investigations

hard_gates: same random market and request stream within each paired protocol comparison
KYC remains authoritative for entity identity
behavior-only output is review_required and cannot deny service
no synthetic result may be labeled external validation or production promotion
non-finite, missing, unhashed, or stale evidence fails closed
promotion_rule: No production promotion is possible before external_validation. Smoke and confirmation runs may only be recorded as smoke_only, diagnostic_only, inconclusive, rejected, blocked, or confirmation_pending.

statistical_rule.multiple_testing: Holm correction for confirmatory cell-wise comparisons
